_about: The judgment half of the movement-parameter register.
The extractors produce the mechanical columns: where a number lives, its
value, its path inside a structure. NOTHING HERE CAN BE COMPUTED. A source,
a scope, a frame and a unit's evidence are read by a person and written
down, and this file is where they are written.
A ROW ABSENT FROM THIS FILE RENDERS AS sourceKind NONE. That is deliberate.
The register's charter says to say NONE loudly, and an unfilled row is
indistinguishable from an unsourced one until somebody fills it, so the
loud reading is the safe default.
AND THIS FILE MUST NOT NAME A ROW NO EXTRACTOR PRODUCED. A sidecar entry
for a constant that does not exist would be population C inside the
register itself: a name reasoned about, carrying a source, denoting
nothing. scripts/register_sidecar_check.py refuses when that happens.

A1 spikes/author_flight.py:DEFAULT_SPEED.sourceScope: it states what the number is FOR. It states nothing about what a netball pass does.
A1 spikes/author_flight.py:DEFAULT_SPEED.regime: authored for a drill feed, spent on every pass in the library including a bounce pass, where 600 must still throw the ball upward at the floor
A1 spikes/author_flight.py:DEFAULT_SPEED.dependants: 15 ball files. 4 carry it directly and 11 carry launchSpeedMetresPerSecond 6.11 to 6.64 DERIVED from it, so the eleven are one constant seen eleven times and not eleven measurements agreeing.
A1 spikes/author_flight.py:DEFAULT_SPEED.whatWouldChangeIt: a coach stating what a drill feed and a game pass are, or a release speed measured from footage that can see the ball leave the hand

A2 spikes/isb_angles.py:AAOS_LIMITS.claim: eight joints of a human body have these ranges of motion, in degrees
A2 spikes/isb_angles.py:AAOS_LIMITS.unitDeclared: degrees, in the RangeLimit field names
A2 spikes/isb_angles.py:AAOS_LIMITS.source: the comment at isb_angles.py:238-239: 'Clinical norms from the American Academy of Orthopaedic Surgeons. These are guidance for a healthy adult. An athlete population needs its own bands.'
A2 spikes/isb_angles.py:AAOS_LIMITS.sourceScope: POPULATION STATED, CITATION INCOMPLETE. The organisation is named in full and the population is 'a healthy adult'. An organisation is not a publication: there is no edition, no page and no document, so a reader cannot check the sixteen numbers.
A2 spikes/isb_angles.py:AAOS_LIMITS.regime: measured on a healthy adult population, spent on an elite netball athlete. THE AUTHOR RECORDED THIS: 'An athlete population needs its own bands.'
A2 spikes/isb_angles.py:AAOS_LIMITS.dependants: build_library.py reads AAOS_LIMITS and checks EVERY drill in the library against it
A2 spikes/isb_angles.py:AAOS_LIMITS.whatWouldChangeIt: the document and edition the numbers came from, then a decision about the athlete population the author already flagged
A2 spikes/isb_angles.py:AAOS_LIMITS.note: This lane first reported the row as 'four letters, no edition, no page, no population' to three lanes, and one repeated it. It had read the table and not the two lines above it.

A2 spikes/contact_solve.py:TWIST_SEEDS.claim: the solver tries these four forearm twists from rest, plus the continuity pose, and keeps the best
A2 spikes/contact_solve.py:TWIST_SEEDS.source: the comment above it: from rest the hand 'rolled the wrong way round and jammed against the pronation limit with the palm facing away', and several seeds remove that failure at about 20 ms
A2 spikes/contact_solve.py:TWIST_SEEDS.sourceScope: NARROWER THAN ITS USE. It proves a pronation-limit jam is removed. It proves nothing about basin stability, and the movement lane's sweeps on 2026-09-09 measured the library still crossing basins with the seeds in place: the overhead pass's step knee reads 0.00 degrees, then +8.40, then 0.00, then +8.30 as one parameter moves.
A2 spikes/contact_solve.py:TWIST_SEEDS.whatWouldChangeIt: a measurement of basin stability across the library, which is a different experiment from the one the comment reports

B release@0.80.claim: the ball leaves the hand at phase 0.80 of the movement
B release@0.80.source: no note in any of the five files derives 0.80. Four describe what the phase MEANS and one has no note at all.
B release@0.80.sourceScope: THE CHEST PASS'S NOTE LOOKS LIKE A DERIVATION AND IS NOT ONE FOR THIS FIELD. It sources the ball OFFSET from netball_two_hand_catch_chest's send_back, and that parent sits at phase 0.92. The note explains some of the entry's numbers and not this one.
B release@0.80.meaning: CONTESTED, then SETTLED BY MEASUREMENT. All four passes have 96 frames, so 0.80 * 95 = 76.0 in every one, and the movement lane measured frame 76 as the FIRST RELEASED frame on all four. THREE OF THE FIVE FILES CALL IT THE LAST FRAME THE HANDS ARE ON THE BALL, which is the frame before.
B release@0.80.dependants: five drills: chest, overhead, bounce and one-hand-high passes, and deflect_high's send_on. deflect_high has 88 frames, so 0.80 * 87 = 69.6 and the phase does not land on a frame boundary at all.
B release@0.80.whatWouldChangeIt: a coach or a measurement stating when the ball leaves the hand. The meaning is settled; the value is not sourced.
